page.layout: One block of verse in a single column, centred under the running head; page number at the top right; signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: Non ille furtum, non tulit hoc scelus
Heu! quanta late tunc per agros
Venti per aequor, quum ciet Aeolus

page.notes: The verse is set in italic type throughout with long s printed as f in places; the transcription normalises long s to s. Some words are partly damaged by the scan (e.g. "Rhenive", "suentes", "Quum" in the margin of line 16); doubtful readings are unmarked but may be affected by the scan's blur. The line-initial capital letters are swash forms.
